transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been trying to clean up my image and get more organized for the arts board stuff, but it’s made me more tense and down than I expected. I’m still doing the basic things, but I keep letting little things slip, like my fair planning notes or design drafts. Then I feel guilty about it and end up canceling plans instead of trying to catch up.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?

Yeah, more than I expected. Since I started trying to get my image and routine together for the arts board, I’ve been feeling tense and kind of down most days. I’m still handling the basics, but I keep letting things like my fair notes or design drafts slip, and then I feel guilty and cancel plans instead of dealing with them.
Did these feelings begin after a specific stressful event?

Yes. It started after I began trying to clean up my image and get more organized for the arts board stuff. I thought it would help, but I’ve just felt more tense and down, and then I fall behind on little things and feel guilty about it.
If the arts board situation were resolved, do you think your low mood and tension would mostly lift?
I think so, yes. The whole reset is still going on, though, so it’s not like this is a separate problem that kept going after the changes were over.
Before this arts board situation started, were you already feeling this same kind of low mood and tension?
No, not like this. It started a few weeks after I began changing my clothes, routines, and who I was spending time with for the arts board image reset.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different things, not just the arts board situation?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed it being about lots of different things—it mostly feels tied to this situation.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed a clear loss of interest, exactly.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite?
I haven’t really noticed any change in my appetite.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed any particular trouble sleeping.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
I’m not sure—I haven’t really noticed any particular problems concentrating.
Have you been feeling hopeless?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really been feeling hopeless.
Lately, have you been getting less pleasure from the things you usually enjoy?
I don’t think so. I’ve still been able to enjoy the things I usually do.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low in energy?
No, I haven’t really felt unusually tired or low on energy.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living?
No, I haven’t had thoughts like that.
Have you been feeling slowed down, like your movements or speech take more effort than usual?
I haven’t really noticed that, no.
Have you been crying more than usual?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed any big change in that.
Have these feelings been interfering with your work or your relationships?

I’m still managing basic errands and commitments, but I’ve been less reliable with the volunteer and creative things people usually count on me for—like planning the fair or following through on design work.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down most of the day nearly every day?

Not nearly every day, I don’t think. But since I started trying to get my image and routine together for the arts board, I’ve been more tense and down than I expected. I’m still doing the basic stuff, but I keep letting things like fair notes or design drafts slip, and then I feel guilty and end up canceling plans instead of catching up.
Does your reaction to the arts board situation feel stronger than you would normally expect for something like this?

Yeah, I think it does. I expected it to be stressful, but not to where I’m still doing the basics and yet letting little things I care about, like the fair notes or design drafts, keep slipping. Then I feel guilty about it and cancel plans instead of catching up.
Have you been feeling worthless?
I wouldn’t say worthless. I’ve been frustrated with myself, but I don’t really feel like I have no value.
